headline: Wired right,
left tidy.
copy.sub: EV chargers, rewires, extensions, outdoor lighting and safety-report fixes across Newbury and West Berkshire. Neat work, a fair price and no mess left behind.
copy.lede: BT Electrical & Lighting is Ben, a local electrician based just outside Newbury. Customers say the same things: he turns up on time, prices fairly, explains what he's doing and leaves the place tidy. From a single socket to a full rewire or an EV charger, it gets the same care.
copy.services_intro: Big jobs and small ones, done properly.

services.title: EV charger installation
services.blurb: Home EV chargers fitted neatly, including tricky earthing set-ups.
services.intro: A tidy install, cables run properly and everything explained before he leaves.

services.title: Rewires
services.blurb: Full and partial rewires planned around your home to keep the mess down.
services.intro: Old wiring brought up to date, with sockets and lights where you actually need them.

services.title: EICR remedial work
services.blurb: Failed electrical safety report? Ben puts it right and gets you compliant.
services.intro: Ideal for landlords: an independent look at the report, the fixes done and everything left safe.
includes: Clear explanation of what was wrong

services.title: Extension wiring
services.blurb: New circuits, lighting and sockets for extensions and conversions.
services.intro: Worked in with your builder so the electrics are right first time.

services.title: Outdoor lighting
services.blurb: Garden, driveway and security lights fitted safely outside.
services.intro: Lights that look good and are wired safely for the weather.

services.title: Small jobs
services.blurb: Sockets, lights, switches, faults. No job too small.
services.intro: The small jobs other electricians don't call back about.
